projects.title: AROX — On-Demand Services Marketplace
projects.description: Full-scale on-demand services marketplace with Client and Craftsman modes in one app (60+ screens) and an Admin Dashboard offering app-wide analytics and full control over the platform. Integrates 92 REST API endpoints covering the full client and craftsman lifecycle from signup to final billing, interactive real-time Google Maps to locate nearby craftsmen and tasks, open-bidding, real-time chat, subscription/commission billing, dispute resolution, and FCM push notifications.

projects.title: Eduon LMS
projects.description: All-in-one learning app with structured learning paths and roadmaps, in-app video streaming with real-time progress tracking, secure Firebase Auth, background notifications, and a community hub connecting 8+ tech organizations (IEEE, GDG).

projects.title: Diety App
projects.description: Smart nutrition & fitness app generating personalized fitness and diet plans, tested by 50+ users. Includes a 1D CNN prototype (trained in Python on 100+ samples) served via a Flask API, plus workout, meal planning, progress tracking, and guided meditation.

projects.title: Eng. Islam Ahmed Office
projects.description: Responsive, dark-themed engineering & training platform for courses and trainee bookings, with a digital engineering library (dynamic filtering) and a portfolio section with file downloads.

projects.title: The 5th Real Estate
projects.description: Responsive real-estate platform listing properties and units across 12+ areas, with advanced search/filtering, direct WhatsApp booking, and a secure Firebase admin dashboard for real-time property management (add, edit, hide, delete), dynamic property forms, and bulk JSON upload.

projects.title: NX Media
projects.description: Responsive, dark-themed landing page for a video editing service with pricing tiers, FAQ, and an order form that generates a pre-filled WhatsApp message with a live price estimate. Built with separate HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files and deployed on Cloudflare Pages.
